That night, and every night after, he flashed the lamp twice toward Port Ellin: yes, I see you.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台没有关紧的收音机，只剩沙沙的底噪。环卫车缓缓驶过，车灯把梧桐叶的影子推得很长。便利店的门半开着，暖气混着关东煮的味道涌出来，值夜班的店员靠着柜台打盹。写字楼的顶层还亮着几扇窗，像不肯睡去的眼睛。远处高架桥上，一辆早班货车驶过，声音被空旷放大，又被黑暗吞没。天边泛起一点极淡的灰蓝，第一班公交从车场里驶出，城市翻了个身，快要醒了。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big job by handing itself a smaller version of the same job, like opening a matryoshka doll by opening the doll inside it.\n• To keep it from going on forever, there has to be a bottom—a smallest doll that just opens, no more dolls inside—called the base case.\n• So the recipe is: if the job is tiny, just do it; otherwise, do one small piece and give the rest of the job back to yourself."}
